# Tugas 7 Third-Party Assets

Imported on 2026-07-01. Only the files listed below are retained in this project.

## ShareTextures — Lava 01

- Source: https://blendatlas.com/products/free-product-lava-textures-1k-2k-1
- Original source: https://www.sharetextures.com/textures/abstract/lava_01
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Retained 1K maps: `Lava_01_basecolor_1K.png`, `Lava_01_emissive_1K.png`,
  `Lava_01_normal_1K.png`, `Lava_01_height_1K.png`, `Lava_01_roughness_1K.png`,
  `Lava_01_metallic_1K.png`, and `Lava_01_ambientocclusion_1K.png`
- Import note: the source WebP maps were losslessly converted to PNG for Unity compatibility.

## Quaternius — Sci-Fi Essentials Kit (Standard)

- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/scifiessentialskit.html
- Download mirror: https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-essentials-kit
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Retained models: `Prop_Barrel1.fbx`, `Prop_Crate_Large.fbx`, `Prop_Locker.fbx`,
  `Prop_SatelliteDish.fbx`, and `Prop_Shelves_WideTall.fbx`
- Retained textures: `T_Props_Batch1_BaseColor.png`, `T_Props_Batch1_Normal.png`,
  `T_Props_Batch1_ORM.png`, `T_Props_Crates_BaseColor.png`,
  `T_Props_Crates_Normal.png`, `T_Props_Crates_ORM.png`,
  `T_Trim_02_BaseColor.png`, `T_Trim_02_Normal.png`, and `T_Trim_02_ORM.png`
- Excluded: weapons, characters, enemies, scripts, demos, source projects, and all
  other unused models and textures.
